bar_callout.note: Type H = high yield. NF/FF near/far face; T/B top/bottom; UB = 'U' bars; B1/B2 = bottom layer 1/2. Wall note 6.5.2 shows an alternative hyphenated form: 20H10-63-150N1; two-face zone: 40H10-63-150 (20N1-20F2). Ambiguity: pitch shown as 200 in drawings vs 150 in note examples - just examples.

layers_of_reinforcement: N near face, F far face; identical bars in different faces itemised separately (unique marks).
bar_marks: 2-digit marks (01,02...) placed at bar end/lead; same mark repeated across plan, elevation and sections; ranged marks '13 (a-k)' for varied bars; leader dot marks the bar; short slash pair marks extent limit.

symbols.section_marker: filled triangle with arrow, section number in adjacent text, grid circle labels (A,1,2...)
symbols.level_marker: inverted filled triangle with level e.g. 12.675
symbols.spacing_zone: dimension-like line with end ticks between extents; '=' marks for equal spacing (representational footing)
symbols.cover_notes: e.g. '75 COVER TO 03', '40 CVR','50 CVR','75 CVR'

wall: sections 1-1 (vertical through thickness), 2-2/3-3 (plan sections at ends/corners)
retaining_wall: basement: plan wall A (detailed with wall B), elevation wall A, sections 1-1,2-2,3-3, key plan
foundations: traditional: plan per footing on grid (BASE K/12) + section 1-1 + cage section 2-2
representational: generic X-Y plan + sections + table (Column ref, No off, Base level, Base steel MK A/MK B, Cage sect., Starters MK C/D)
stairs: plan (flight B with landing, 2 No THUS)
key plan STAIR S1/S2 with flights A/B/C

cross_references: Starter bars for slabs (MS2 B/C) detailed with wall drawings else cross-referenced; column starters shown on footing drawings or comprehensive cross referencing essential; 'SEE PANEL B/D', 'SEE SLAB DRG', 'See drg R021'.
dimensioning: Lap/extension dimensions leader to bar mark; cover dims; kicker 75/150; 'Structural floor level'; spacing via 'pitch' in callout; levels in m to 3 dp.
